sourceBranches: ROS 2 rolling / main branches of the repositories listed in the document (fetched 2026-09-30)

bindings.name: navigate_to_pose
bindings.parameterMap: location → pose (PoseStamped, frame map); heading → pose.orientation
bindings.conversions: lat/lon → map frame with robot_localization service /fromLL (GeoPoint → Point); ENU yaw = π/2 − heading (rad), wrapped to (−π, π]; quaternion about z
bindings.notes: speed, acceptanceRadius, holdTime, passThrough are not goal fields (controller and goal-checker parameters). Commands carrying them are rejected.

bindings.name: follow_gps_waypoints
bindings.parameterMap: location → gps_poses[0] (GeoPose); heading → orientation
bindings.conversions: Nav2 converts lat/lon itself through /fromLL; ENU yaw = π/2 − heading (rad), wrapped to (−π, π]; quaternion about z
bindings.notes: Single-element list. Same unsupported parameters as above.

bindings.name: cmd/command_int
bindings.parameterMap: DO_REPOSITION (192): speed → param1, location → x (lat×1e7), y (lon×1e7), z
bindings.conversions: degE7 integer conversion; frame from vertical reference
bindings.notes: Guided-mode reposition; supports speed, heading (param4 yaw).

bindings.name: uxs/vehicle/goto
bindings.parameterMap: field names are the registry parameter names in snake_case

bindings.name: follow_gps_waypoints
bindings.parameterMap: path → gps_poses[]; closed → not supported
bindings.conversions: Nav2 converts lat/lon; orientations derived from path direction
bindings.notes: Waypoint task executors run at each waypoint and are configured by parameters, not per goal.

bindings.name: navigate_through_poses
bindings.parameterMap: path → poses (Goals, frame map)
bindings.conversions: lat/lon → map frame with robot_localization service /fromLL (GeoPoint → Point)
bindings.notes: Through-poses planning; interpolation is planner-defined.

bindings.name: follow_path
bindings.parameterMap: path → path (nav_msgs/Path in map); controller ids left empty
bindings.conversions: lat/lon → map frame with robot_localization service /fromLL (GeoPoint → Point)
bindings.notes: Follows a given path exactly; no planning. speed is not a goal field.

bindings.name: spin
bindings.parameterMap: heading → target_yaw (relative), direction → sign
bindings.conversions: relative yaw = wrap(ENU yaw target − current yaw from TF); ENU yaw = π/2 − heading (rad), wrapped to (−π, π]; quaternion about z
bindings.notes: target_yaw is a relative rotation in radians. rate, lock unsupported.
